environment.description: ECS Fargate service running the Go binary. The task role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/profile-svc-role) has a broad DynamoDB policy: Action dynamodb:UpdateItem on resource arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111122223333:table/UserProfiles with no condition keys. API Gateway passes JWT-validated X-User-ID header. No WAF or input filtering layer.

config.network: Private subnet, ALB with no WAF
config.runtime: ECS Fargate, Go 1.21, no seccomp override
